{{Top}}
The '''logra''' was a dangerous burrowing predator native to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] that hunted [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]]. When [[A'Deen]] returned from the rites of adulthood, [[A'Yark/Legends|A'Yark]] didn't want to be here and lamented what became of the ritual. Because the [[Yark clan]] was hiding in [[The Pillars]], where krayts were rare, the Tusken youth were forced to [[Death/Legends|kill]] other creatures in the rites, such as logras, instead of [[Krayt dragon/Legends|krayt dragons]] by the elders' decree. A'Yark thought the elders' decree was cowardly.<ref name="Kenobi">[[Kenobi (novel)|''Kenobi'']]</ref>
